ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central field with approximately 25-30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixel distribution concentrated at the distal tips and along the trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey to black mottling clusters located at the extreme outer tips and extending along the length of the trailing edge. High density of yellowish-brown circular focal spots distributed throughout the white-intensity areas of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 50 degrees, bisecting the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, serrated trailing edge with high-frequency peaks (approx 5-15 pixel amplitude) most pronounced on the distal thirds of each lobe; smoother, lower-amplitude variations occur closer to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a generally concave sweep from the tips toward the median notch; leading edge exhibits a strong convex curve before entering the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial distribution of circular, high-contrast yellowish-brown pixel clusters across approximately 70% of the visible ventral surface, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Minor horizontal and diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the central and lower regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant surface pitting and circular discoloration patterns; jagged, irregular tissue loss/notching at the outer distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct 'thumbprint' black mottling pattern restricted to the periphery against a large, clean white central fluke field.
